capabilities: scan vault markdown files for Key: value fields
display notes as a sortable, filterable table
resize, reorder, and toggle table columns
open a note from its table row
extras: Not yet in the community plugin browser; must be installed manually from release files, and it is unreviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Notes with structured fields are scattered across the vault, and Obsidian offers no built-in way to see them all in one sortable, filterable table.
summary: Table view that scans vault notes for Key: value fields and displays them as one sortable, filterable table with clickable titles.
